scientific_integrity: The proof is an analytic exterior-power singular-value asymptotic; numerical checks only corroborate normalizations. No claim of independent review or formal machine certification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed eigenvalue index, bounded positive-measure real windows, frequency dilation t→0; no uniform n or windows, no quantitative rates, no closed finite-bandwidth spectrum. Unindexed priority precedent remains possible.
title: Fixed-index low-bandwidth spectra for arbitrary two-window Fourier concentration
